sources_used: Land Securities Group plc FY21-FY25 Annual Reports + H126 results (https://landsec.com/investors)
_ordering_rationale: REIT UK : Net Rental Income (KPI maitre), EPRA NTA (NAV par action), like-for-like ERV, occupancy, Cost ratio.

kpis.signal: Croissance NRI post-recentrage retail destination + central London, like-for-like +5% FY25
kpis.description_fr: Revenu locatif net groupe Landsec (loyers - charges non recouvrées). KPI maitre des REITs, mesure création valeur opérationnelle.
kpis.description_en: Landsec group Net Rental Income (rents - unrecovered costs). REIT master KPI, measures operational value creation.

kpis.signal: Stabilisation NAV après corrections 2022-2024 (taux + valuation yields), retour creation valeur FY25
kpis.description_fr: EPRA NTA (Net Tangible Assets) par action Landsec. Mesure NAV propre aux REITs européens (excl. goodwill + IRS valuations).
kpis.description_en: Landsec EPRA NTA (Net Tangible Assets) per share. European REIT-specific NAV metric (excl. goodwill + IRS valuations).

kpis.signal: Taux occupation au plus haut, ~98% prime central London + retail destination (Bluewater, Westgate)
kpis.description_fr: Taux occupation portefeuille Landsec. ~98% prime central London (offices + retail destination Bluewater, Westgate Oxford).
kpis.description_en: Landsec portfolio occupancy rate. ~98% prime central London (offices + retail destinations Bluewater, Westgate Oxford).

kpis.signal: ERV en hausse continue, prime London offices + retail destination en growth, central London tight market
kpis.description_fr: Croissance like-for-like Estimated Rental Value (ERV). Mesure pricing power des loyers à magasins comparables.
kpis.description_en: Like-for-like Estimated Rental Value (ERV) growth. Measures rental pricing power on comparable assets.

kpis.signal: Efficacité en hausse, ratio coût administratif total / loyers brut. Cible <22% à moyen terme.
kpis.description_fr: Ratio total des coûts d'exploitation Landsec / loyers bruts. Mesure efficacité du gestionnaire d'actifs REIT. Cible <22%.
kpis.description_en: Landsec Total Cost Ratio (operating costs / gross rental income). REIT operator efficiency metric. Target <22%.

kpis.signal: Stabilisation valorisation post-corrections 2022-2024, valuation yield 6.4% (prime offices central London)
kpis.description_fr: Valorisation portefeuille immobilier total Landsec. Stabilisation post-corrections 2022-2024 (hausse taux), valuation yield 6.4%.
kpis.description_en: Landsec total property portfolio valuation. Stabilization post-2022-2024 corrections (rate hikes), 6.4% valuation yield.

_notes: Landsec FY se termine 31 mars. Sources : Annual Reports FY21-FY25 + H126 results. Spécialisation prime central London offices + UK retail destinations.
